turns.result_text_tail:
oard decision, in the navy theme.
- Only the briefing pack was used. I set aside its $5.2B "US K-beauty market" figure because it also counts makeup and hair care; a backup slide explains this.
- I read "on the way to $40M by 2030" strictly, as $40M of US revenue in 2030.
- The ad-cost and duty scenarios hold one rate for all of 2027–2030, the same way the planning team modeled them.
- Left out of scope: direct-to-consumer and mass-retail routes (not modeled in the pack), makeup and hair care, other markets, and price changes. These are on a "what we did not pursue" slide.
- The owners in the next steps and the risk table (US launch lead, CFO, COO, Head of Japan) are roles I proposed. Change them if needed.

**Numbers:** 271 data points, each traced either to a table or line in the briefing pack or to a live formula in the workbook. There are no placeholders. Every number is graded B: it matches its source, but the pack is the only source and there was no web check. Of the 11 hypotheses tested, 4 were confirmed, 3 revised and 4 refuted. All figures in the pack are synthetic, and the cover says so.

The storyline spec (`onsoo-us-entry.json`) is included, so the deck can be re-rendered in another theme or with new inputs. A useful next step is to replace the flat ad-cost scenarios with an ad-cost path by year, if you get agency or pilot data on how it changes as sales grow.

Files are in `./deliverable/`:
- onsoo-us-entry.pptx
- onsoo-us-entry-sources.xlsx
- onsoo-us-entry.json

prompt:
/hire-your-mck Create a deck for Onsoo Botanicals' CEO and board: Should Onsoo enter the US market in 2027, and if so, by which route?

The briefing pack in ./evidence/briefing-pack.md has everything that is available: work only from it. Web research is not available.

Save the finished deliverable in ./deliverable/.

I won't be available to answer questions while you work. Wherever you would ask me something, choose the option you would recommend, note your choice, and carry on until the deliverable is finished.
